{{Quote|I ended up eating zoochberries almost daily, and one of my favorite ways to have them was in a fine cobbler such as this one.|The menu of Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''Zoochberry cobbler''' was a dessert dish containing [[Zoochberry/Legends|zoochberries]] which was [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Besalisk [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] first tasted the [[Berry/Legends|berries]] while trading [[furbog]]s on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], eating them [[Standard day/Legends|daily]]. One of his preferred methods of ingesting them was in a zoochberry cobbler. Jettster later served cobblers at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dex" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> Jettster described the cobblers as "fine" in his menu, where he charged 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the dish and a total of 5.7 credits to serve it with a scoop of [[Denta bean ice cream]].<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zoochberry cobbler was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" />
